thought.text:
**Temuan paling penting sejauh ini.** Perhatikan header request asli:

```
referer, user-agent, content-type, sec-ch-ua...
```

**TIDAK ADA header token Turnstile sama sekali!**

Dan body-nya:
```json
{"email","password","name","callbackURL":"/overview"}
```

Jadi token Turnstile **tidak dikirim lewat header** — kemungkinan lewat **cookie** yang di-set Cloudflare. Saya periksa cookie saat submit.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 220 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -22
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time,json
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    ctx=b.new_context(); pg=ctx.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://dash.allmodels.io/signup",wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    for fr in pg.frames:
        if "challenges.cloudflare.com" in fr.url:
            try: fr.click("body",timeout=6000)
            except Exception: pass
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    print("token input:", pg.eval_on_selector('input[name="cf-turnstile-response"]','e=>e.value')[:50])
    print("=== cookies ===")
    for c in ctx.cookies():
        print(f"  {c['name']} ({c['domain']}) len={len(c['value'])}")
    b.close()
PY
